question: Avengers: Infinity War never shows Xandar: Thanos taking the Power Stone there happens before the film and is only mentioned in dialogue (Thor: "he stole it last week when he decimated Xandar"). Does a dialogue-only, off-screen event count as on screen?
options: Keep the entry (stated in the film's dialogue)
Remove the entry (the event is not shown on screen)
evidence: Thor says Thanos already has the Power Stone because he stole it last week when he decimated Xandar; the film opens on the Statesman with the stone already in Thanos's gauntlet. Xandar itself never appears.

e: The Guardians stop Ronan from destroying the planet with the Power Stone.
Thanos takes the Power Stone from Xandar.

evidence: Afterlife does not appear in episode 44 (S.O.S. Part Two): that episode is the Inhumans' attack aboard the Iliad, at sea, and its location list has no Nepal or Afterlife. question: Where should Wakanda's pin go? It is at [1.5, 30.5] (Lake Albert, on the Uganda and DR Congo border). The on-screen map in Captain America: Civil War puts Wakanda around Lake Turkana, where Uganda, Kenya, South Sudan and Ethiopia meet (about [4, 36]). The Art of Black Panther book puts it in the East African Rift, bordering Rwanda, DR Congo and Uganda.
options: Move to the Lake Turkana area, about [4, 36] (the on-screen Civil War map)
evidence: MCU wiki Wakanda trivia: 'In Captain America: Civil War, Wakanda is depicted as a small area around Lake Turkana, a point where Uganda, Kenya, South Sudan, and Ethiopia meet ... The Art of Black Panther, however, depicts it in the East African Rift Valley, bordering Rwanda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and Uganda.' The owner's rule says only what's on screen counts, which points to Lake Turkana.

question: The Avengers' Project Pegasus base (Joint Dark Energy Mission Facility) is filed under New Mexico. The MCU wiki's infobox gives its location as the Mojave Desert, Nevada, but its own trivia says the Phase One tie-in book puts it in New Mexico, and the exteriors were shot in Albuquerque. The film itself names no state. Keep it under New Mexico?
options: Keep under New Mexico (the tie-in book; Thor's New Mexico link)
Move to a Mojave Desert / Nevada place (the MCU wiki's infobox)
evidence: Joint Dark Energy Mission Facility infobox: 'location = Mojave Desert, Nevada'. Trivia: 'In Phase One: Marvel's The Avengers, the facility is in New Mexico.' Behind the scenes: the exterior is Atrisco Heritage Academy High School in Albuquerque.

question: Spider-Man (1994)#18 (Mutants' Revenge): the entry puts Rogue flirting with Spider-Man and Wolverine joining his hunt at the mansion, but the full synopsis has Spider-Man only in Manhattan. Wolverine meets him there, they raid Landon's building, and the X-Men fly in by Blackbird. The mansion shows up only as the War Room. No source mentions Rogue flirting. Spider-Man's visit to the mansion is episode 17, which already has an entry. What to do with this entry?
options: Drop the entry from the mansion (the team-up belongs on the New York pin)
Rewrite it to a mansion event once one is confirmed on screen
evidence: Marvel Database 'Spider-Man: The Animated Series Season 2 5' full synopsis: Spider-Man and Wolverine fight and team up outside and inside Landon's building in Manhattan, and the X-Men arrive in the Blackbird. Its locations list Xavier's School only through the War Room. Season 2 4 (episode 17) is the mansion visit.

item.r: Salem Center, Westchester County, New York
